lede: Town Council meets Monday and the agenda is unusually loaded: first readings on two ordinances — one touching the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program — plus action on the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA, which ties directly to the SMART 3A dollars voters approved for gondola replacement. Ouray County is also busy, with commissioners weighing a fifth extension of their Emergency Disaster Declaration and a separate work session drilling into a potential EMS-Ridgway Fire merger. And yes, it's Halloween week — parade Friday, the TMHS Young Frankenstein run, the Witches Ride Thursday, and a Remembrance Garden dedication Tuesday.

notable.stake: Council votes on gondola IGA supplement and two ordinances, including energy mitigation changes.
Commissioners may extend Emergency Disaster Declaration a fifth time — a significant ongoing commitment.
EMS and Ridgway Fire merger draft agreement under review — shapes emergency response for years.
P&Z hears lot-line vacation and merger application in the historic West Telluride Addition.
